media.alt_text:
Aranka  
10/17/23
To: POTUS
Dear Mr. President and Mrs. Vice President, 
I just opened a notice.... I let it sit about a week and a half before opening, because I knew it would tell me how much I would have to start repaying each month, which would be an amount I could not afford to pay at this time. Instead, what it said was... that my student loans have been forgiven in full. Around $38k. I am overwhelmed. I am overwhelmed with gratitude. I have always had faith in our system, but lately, well. It's been difficult. It's easy to lose faith in our current system. But today, I can say that the system has tangibly changed my life for the better... And I very sincerely thank you for it. You don't know what this means to me.
Thank you,
Aranka

media.alt_text:
First 10 Drugs Selected For Medicare Price Negotiation Under The Biden-Harris Administration

Stelara

Treats: Psoriasis, Psoriatic Arthritis, Crohn’s Disease, Ulcerative Colitis

Around 20,000 People on Medicare Annually Rely on Stelara…
- Seniors spent over $41 million out-of-pocket on Stelara in 2022
- Average out-of-pocket cost for Stelara in 2022 was $4,207
- Out-of-pocket spending on Stelara increased 190% from 2018-22

…While Big Pharma Makes Record Profits
- Stelara’s seller executed over $77 billion in stock buybacks since the drug launched
- Stelara’s seller spent over $91 million on lobbying since the drug launched 
- Big Pharma spent nearly $400 million on lobbying in 2022 alone
